kicker.zh-Hans: 一个 App · 装所有游戏

title.zh-Hans: 装一次 S2Arm，游戏一款一款加进去
title.en: Install S2Arm once, then add games one by one

what.zh-Hans: 以前每款游戏是一个单独的 App；现在手机上**只有一个 S2Arm**，所有游戏都在它的游戏库里。
what.en: Games used to be separate apps; now there is **one S2Arm** on your phone and every game is in its library.

how.zh-Hans: 先在电脑上把 S2Arm 装到手机，以后哪款想玩就把哪款「**推到 iPhone**」。S2Arm 更新时**不用重新推游戏**，存档也都在。
how.en: Install S2Arm on your phone from the computer, then **Push to iPhone** whichever game you want to play. Updating S2Arm **doesn't mean sending games again**, and your saves stay.

where.zh-Hans: iPhone 主屏上的 S2Arm 图标，打开就是游戏库。
where.en: The S2Arm icon on your iPhone Home Screen opens the library.

kicker.zh-Hans: 推游戏的新方式 · 两个入口各管一件事
kicker.en: A new way to add games · One place for each job

title.zh-Hans: 装 App 和推游戏分开了
title.en: Installing the app and sending games are now separate

what.zh-Hans: 以前出包会把游戏和 App 打成一个包；现在 **S2Arm 这个 App 只装一次**，每款游戏单独「**推到 iPhone**」，只推这一款。
what.en: Export used to build the game and the app into one package. Now **the S2Arm app is installed once** and each game is sent on its own with **Push to iPhone**.

how.zh-Hans: 第一次：连上手机，在游戏库第一格的「S2Arm」里点「**安装 S2Arm**」。之后：选一款游戏，点「**推到 iPhone**」。快到 7 天时，同一处的按钮变成「**续签 S2Arm**」，点一下就行，游戏不用重推。
how.en: The first time, connect your phone and click **Install S2Arm** on the S2Arm card at the start of the library. After that, pick a game and click **Push to iPhone**. When the 7 days are nearly up, the same button becomes **Renew S2Arm**; one click, no games to send again.

where.zh-Hans: 装 App、续签、更新：游戏库**第一格的「S2Arm」**。推游戏：每款游戏下面的「**推到 iPhone**」。
where.en: Installing, renewing and updating the app: **the S2Arm card at the start of the library**. Sending a game: **Push to iPhone** under each game.

kicker.zh-Hans: 自签玩家 · 不用电脑也能导入

title.zh-Hans: 用 AltStore / SideStore 的，手机上就能导入游戏
title.en: Using AltStore / SideStore? Import games right on your phone

what.zh-Hans: 把 AltStore / SideStore 的签名证书导进 S2Arm，之后电脑导出的或朋友分享的游戏，放进手机就能玩。**不用电脑登录 Apple ID，也不用新建证书。**
what.en: Bring your AltStore / SideStore signing certificate into S2Arm, and games exported from your computer or shared by a friend play as soon as you put them on the phone. **No Apple ID sign-in on a computer, no new certificate.**

how.zh-Hans: ① 在 AltStore 或 SideStore 的设置里「**导出签名证书**」，设一个密码。② 打开 S2Arm：齿轮 →「**签名证书**」→「**导入 .p12…**」，选这份证书，输入密码。③ 把 .s2arm 和 .img 放进 S2Arm 的「**放这里导入**」。
how.en: ① In AltStore or SideStore settings, **export your signing certificate** and set a password. ② Open S2Arm: gear → **Signing certificate** → **Import .p12…**, pick the certificate and enter the password. ③ Put the .s2arm and .img files into S2Arm's **Import Here** folder.

where.zh-Hans: 同一个 Apple ID 只在一台电脑的 AltServer 上管理：两台电脑都用会互相作废证书，AltStore 会弹「Multiple AltServers」。每 7 天在 AltStore 里点「Refresh All」续签。
where.en: Manage each Apple ID from AltServer on only one computer: using two makes them revoke each other's certificates, and AltStore shows "Multiple AltServers". Refresh every 7 days with Refresh All in AltStore.

kicker.zh-Hans: 从 0.5 升级 · 两步换到新 App
kicker.en: Upgrading from 0.5 · Two steps to the new app

title.zh-Hans: 老游戏和存档都在，点两下就接上
title.en: Your games and saves stay. Two clicks and you're back

what.zh-Hans: 0.6.0 起手机上统一用一个 S2Arm 装所有游戏。你手机上原来的游戏、存档、游戏数据**都会留着**，不用重新出包，也不用重传游戏数据。
what.en: From 0.6.0 there is one S2Arm app for all your games. The games, saves and game data already on your phone **all stay**; no exporting again, no sending game data again.

how.zh-Hans: ① Mac 玩家先在 S2Arm 里**用 Apple ID 登录一次**。② 连上手机，在游戏库第一格的「S2Arm」里点「**更新 S2Arm**」：先把各款存档备份到电脑，再换成新 App。③ 装完同一页列出这台手机上要更新的旧游戏，默认全勾，点「**更新这 N 款**」，每款约 1–2 分钟；旧版做的着色器库电脑会顺带重做，第一次要几分钟到几十分钟。**不用点 S 级优化**。
how.en: ① On a Mac, **sign in with your Apple ID once** in S2Arm. ② Connect your phone and click **Update S2Arm** on the S2Arm card at the start of the library: your saves are backed up to the computer first, then the new app goes on. ③ Right after, the same page lists the old games on this phone, all checked: click **Update these N games**, about 1–2 minutes each. Shader libraries built by the old version are rebuilt by the computer too; the first time takes from a few minutes to a few tens of minutes. **No need for S-grade optimization.**

where.zh-Hans: 第 ③ 步做完之前，这些游戏在手机上显示「**在电脑上更新一次**」，点不进去，但没丢。别的电脑装的另起一行列出，到那台电脑上更新。用 AltStore 等自己签名的：装新 S2Arm 覆盖旧的，再把每款 .s2arm 导入一次。
where.en: Until step ③ is done, those games show **Update once on your computer** on the phone and won't open, but they aren't gone. Games installed from another computer are listed on a separate line; update them on that computer. If you sign the app yourself with AltStore or similar: install the new S2Arm over the old one, then import each game's .s2arm once.

title.zh-Hans: 随时存下当前这一刻，下次从这里接着玩
title.en: Save the moment you're in and pick up right there next time

what.zh-Hans: 不用等游戏自己的存档点，点一下就把此刻的游戏状态整个存下来，之后能回到这一刻。
what.en: No need to wait for the game's own save point; one tap saves the whole game as it is right now, and you can come back to it.

how.zh-Hans: 游戏里点右上角的半透明按钮就存；长按它选「**回到上次存下的这一刻**」。下次打开游戏库，最上面的「**从这一刻继续**」点一下直接进。
how.en: In a game, tap the translucent button in the top-right corner to save; press and hold it and choose **Go back to the saved moment**. Next time, **Continue from this moment** at the top of the library takes you straight there.

where.zh-Hans: 每款只留最新一份，新存的会盖掉旧的。每份约 0.3～1.2 GB（随游戏不同），占手机空间：长按可以删除，腾出空间；不想用可以在设置里关掉。快照只在存下它的那台设备上可用。
where.en: Each game keeps only the latest one, and a new save replaces the old. Each takes about 0.3–1.2 GB of your phone's storage, depending on the game: press and hold to delete it and free the space, or turn snapshots off in Settings. A snapshot only works on the device that saved it.

title.zh-Hans: 每款游戏占多少，一眼看清
title.en: See what each game takes on your Mac

what.zh-Hans: 每款游戏的占用分项列出：**着色器与出包缓存、Mac 运行版本、已出好的 iPhone 包**，各占多少一眼看清；存档和日志只显示大小、不会被删。
what.en: Each game's space is broken down: **shaders and build cache, the Mac build, ready iPhone builds**, each with its size. Saves and logs only show their size and are never deleted.

how.zh-Hans: 空间不够时，勾上不要的项点「释放」。删了的部分下次需要时会重新准备，手机上已装的游戏不受影响。
how.en: When space runs low, check what you don't need and click Free up. Deleted parts are prepared again when needed; games already on your phone keep working.

where.zh-Hans: 每款游戏的「…」菜单里的「**释放空间**」；旁边的「存储总览」看全部游戏。
where.en: **Free up space** in each game's ••• menu; Storage overview next to it shows every game.

title.en: No more hitch when you enter a new area

what.zh-Hans: 出包时多做一步「**编译着色器库**」：把这款游戏的着色器提前编成苹果显卡的格式，进游戏时不用现编，第一次走进新场景卡一下的情况更少。
what.en: Exporting includes **Compile shader library**: the game's shaders are compiled for Apple graphics ahead of time, so they don't have to be compiled while you play and new areas hitch less the first time.

how.zh-Hans: 什么都不用做，照常出包。大游戏这一步要多花一些时间。
how.en: Nothing to do; export as usual. Big games take a bit longer on this step.

where.zh-Hans: 出包进度里的「编译着色器库」。从 0.5 升上来的游戏，点「更新这 N 款」时电脑会按新版重编。
where.en: The Compile shader library step in the export progress. For games from 0.5, the computer rebuilds them for the new version when you click Update these N games.
